tree.heading: Federal Charter.—
tree.text: United Service Organizations, Incorporated (in this chapter, the “corporation”), is a federally chartered corporation.

tree.heading: Perpetual Existence.—
tree.text: Except as otherwise provided, the corporation has perpetual existence.
